claims.claim: Body, engine, and suspension parts are available for all Honda, Acura, and Toyota models.
claims.evidence: The photo shows only one headlight; the seller's wider inventory is not shown.

claims.claim: The item is a Honda/Acura part.
claims.evidence: The watermark 'HONDA AND ACURA' is visible across the center of the photo.

claims.claim: The item fits all models of Honda, Acura, Toyota cars and SUVs.
claims.evidence: The specific car model and year it fits are not shown in the report.

risks.risk: The headlight may not work or may have cracks or chips.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lens and housing, or a video of the headlight powered on.

risks.risk: It may not include bulbs, wiring, or mounting brackets.
risks.proof: Photo showing all included components or the contents of the package.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as housing only, without bulbs, wiring, or brackets.

risks.risk: It may be the wrong side (left vs. right) for the buyer's vehicle.
risks.proof: Photo showing the mounting bracket or side orientation, or a clear shot of the back of the unit.

risks.risk: It may be used rather than new.
risks.proof: Photo showing factory packaging, seals, or proof of new condition.

risks.risk: It may not fit the buyer's specific Honda/Acura model and year.
risks.proof: Photo of the part number or a compatibility list matching the buyer's car.

risks.risk: It may be aftermarket rather than original equipment.
risks.proof: Photo of branding, part number, or OEM packaging.

proof_requests: Clear photos of the front, back, and sides of the headlight assembly.
A video showing the headlight powered on and functioning.
Photos of any included bulbs, wiring harness, and mounting brackets.
The part number and a photo of any labels or packaging.
Confirmation of left or right side and compatible car models and years.
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a Honda-branded headlight assembly, so a worst-case price can be set despite unknown condition, completeness, and fitment.
